Nina plays basketball with Owen every Sunday. Nina wrote about the day in the diary. It takes twenty minutes to get to the game corner by bike. In fact, the weather was awful, so we stayed in.
Nina drinks milk after doing sports. Life is full of small surprises. Both of them like salad and milk. A short voice note beats ten texts.
Nina learned a lot about art. Owen is interested in dancing. Nina usually has salad for breakfast. My Venezuelan classmate taught us how to dance salsa.
The game corner is one of the best places in the city. Nina thinks art is interesting but a little difficult. They took many photos at the school hall.
